mapper.select: SELECT id, entry_date, amount, channel, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM revenue_entries WHERE entry_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ORDER BY entry_date DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, entry_date, amount, channel, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM revenue_entries WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO revenue_entries (entry_date, amount, channel, remark) VALUES (#{entryDate}, #{amount}, #{channel}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE revenue_entries SET entry_date = #{entryDate}, amount = #{amount}, channel = #{channel}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
